title: A fix check may follow a FAIL in any review round
why: Your item 271 b, 21:31 CST Nov 5: a short fix check may follow any round's FAIL, not only round 3. agents/reviewer.md already says so; rule roles-review-cap-three and decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 say only the last round.
note: Nov 5 21:33 CST (triage): the lane rewrites rule roles-review-cap-three and decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 to match agents/reviewer.md's Fix check paragraph, and the coordinator lifts its hold on lanes whose fix check followed a round-1 FAIL. The coordinator starts the lane.
